messages.forget.title: Delete your data?
messages.forget.confirm:
This permanently deletes your pending reminders and any other scheduled jobs, and removes your id from server settings you changed (the settings stay). It cannot be undone. Messages you sent and anything Discord stores are not affected.

Press the button within 5 minutes to confirm.
messages.forget.unavailable: Aha keeps no personal data in a database in this deployment, so there is nothing to delete. Operational logs are covered by the privacy policy.
messages.forget.done: Done. Deleted {jobs} reminder(s) and scheduled job(s) and removed your id from {settings} server setting(s).
